title: Actionist Block Contract v1
description: Canonical research-only contract shape. It defines machine-checkable fields and includes a synthetic not_admitted fixture; it does not implement runtime behavior or admit a block.

x-source-basis.limitation: Does not prove semantics, authorization, tenancy, or legal clearance.

x-source-basis.applicability: License, copyright, relationship, and SBOM facts.
x-source-basis.limitation: Does not decide permission or legal meaning.
Metadata is not legal clearance.
Does not prove behavior, rights, or safety.
Strength depends on issuer, predicate, and verification.

x-source-basis.applicability: Trust roots, expiry, rotation, and rollback protection.
x-source-basis.limitation: Does not assess code quality or policy correctness.
Identity and transport are not admission or runtime proof.

x-source-basis.applicability: Source to transform to artifact lineage.
x-source-basis.limitation: A provenance graph cannot make an assertion true.

x-source-basis.limitation: Does not prove live provider behavior.

Does not prove ordering or delivery.
Does not prove domain semantics or idempotency.
Tool schemas and hints are not authority or rollback.
Does not prove user intent or execution safety.

x-source-basis.applicability: Delegated subject, actor, and audience token relationships.
x-source-basis.limitation: Does not enforce domain policy or consent.

x-source-basis.applicability: Fresh signed HTTP components and replay fields.
x-source-basis.limitation: Only useful when verifier policy checks the right fields.
Not a local implementation receipt.
Cannot fix bad policy or human intent.
Telemetry does not prove truth or privacy-safe retention.
Does not prove visual quality or accessibility.
Does not prove all components consume tokens.
Does not replace manual usability review.

x-source-basis.applicability: Symbols, references, rename, and source spans.
x-source-basis.limitation: Navigation is not semantic safety.

x-source-basis.applicability: Delegated task, artifact, capability, and idempotency vocabulary.
x-source-basis.limitation: Interoperability does not replace local authority.

x-source-basis.applicability: Cost lineage, correction, reconciliation, and freshness.
x-source-basis.limitation: Does not supply local prices or margins.

x-source-basis.applicability: Flag context, hooks, and kill-switch shape.
x-source-basis.limitation: Flags can hide semantic regressions.

Identity does not authorize every action.

x-fixture.description: Synthetic read-only fixture for validating the v1 contract. It is not a converted repository or runtime implementation.

claims: Schema shape and field relationships only.
No external source, client record, credential, or side effect is used.
non_claims: No implementation, deployment, adoption, client value, or authenticated behavior is established.

atom.trigger: A bounded research request asks for a tenant-scoped read-model view.
atom.outcome: Expose a deterministic explanation of synthetic records without changing an authoritative system.
atom.source_of_truth: Synthetic fixture only; no Actionist database or client system is bound.

rules: Read-only query scope must be explicit.
Unknown authority or tenant scope denies execution.
decision.human_role: Human review is required before any future write or release decision.

side_effect.description: No external write, message, payment, deploy, browser action, migration, or credential operation is declared.

postconditions: Tenant scope is explicit or the operation is denied.

recovery.description: Discard the synthetic run and rebuild from the identified fixture; no external state needs reversal.

audit.retention: Retention period is not set; policy owner must define it before execution.

outputs.name: read_model_result
outputs.description: Deterministic synthetic records and explanation fields
outputs.postcondition: Result digest and fixture snapshot are recorded.

data.name: synthetic_records
data.description: Synthetic rows used only to exercise the contract
data.tenant_scope: tenant_id must be explicit; missing or mismatched scope denies.

ui.name: read_model_view
ui.description: Read-only view with status explanation and local acknowledgement state

actions.name: observe_read_model
actions.description: Read-only observation; no write or external side effect

idempotency.duplicate_behavior: same fingerprint may reuse the same receipt

recovery.boundary: No external state exists to reverse.

states.description: Research design or candidate with no admission decision.
exit_conditions: Later review may move it to candidate; no automatic promotion.

states.description: Source and atom are recorded for review.
entry_conditions: Source identity and scope are recorded.
exit_conditions: Provenance and contract mapping are complete or quarantine applies.

states.description: Required receipts are specified but not all executed.
exit_conditions: All required proofs pass or the item is held.

states.description: A named owner can review the evidence bundle.
Admitted only for an explicit host and scope after all gates.
entry_conditions: All hard gates pass and human decision is recorded.

states.description: Released for a named host and tenant scope with release evidence.
entry_conditions: Immutable release and rollback target exist.

states.description: Evidence is missing, contradicted, stale, or failed.
entry_conditions: Any hard gate is absent or fails.
exit_conditions: New evidence returns to review or rejection.

states.description: A hard falsifier or incompatible boundary prevents use.
A prior decision is withdrawn for a rights, security, or contract reason.
Release returns to a prior known-good target or compensation path.
entry_conditions: Rollback or compensation receipt is complete.

transitions.guard: Source identity, atom, boundary, and owner fields are explicit.
Ports, state, authority, rights, tenancy, recovery, and falsifiers are declared.
All applicable execution gates pass on the exact artifact and environment.
No missing or failed receipt is silently treated as pass.
Named human decision covers exact host, tenant, scope, digest, and expiry.
Silence, chat, or model output is not approval.
Immutable artifact, target, owner, health, and rollback references exist.
Recovery owner records the domain-specific recovery path.

invariants: No candidate enters a production build or release path.
not_admitted is the default for this research artifact and never auto-promotes.
Code rollback, data recovery, workflow replay, credential revocation, and external-effect compensation are separate controls.
A later green receipt must identify its artifact, environment, and new receipt.

idempotency_replay.replay_window: Must be explicit and bounded before execution; not set in this fixture.
idempotency_replay.duplicate_behavior: Same key and fingerprint returns the original receipt; a different fingerprint is denied.
idempotency_replay.conflict_behavior: Emit replay_conflict and do not execute.
idempotency_replay.checkpointing: Not executed; future durable workflows must pin history and checkpoint IDs.
idempotency_replay.determinism: Not claimed; repeated-run reliability remains unexecuted.
idempotency_replay.external_effect_replay: Denied by default; no external effect is declared.

authority_consent.principal_binding: Bind human or service principal to tenant and resource scope; unknown principal denies.
authority_consent.actor_binding: Record agent/tool identity separately; model text cannot grant authority.
authority_consent.tenant_binding: Tenant/resource scope appears in request, policy decision, receipt, and audit trace.

consent.notice: Show purpose, data scope, retention, and effect before operation.
consent.record: Not executed; no client or private data is used.

expiry.max_age: Must be defined by host policy before execution.
expiry.stale_approval_behavior: Deny and require a fresh decision.

authority_consent.commit_time_policy: Recheck current principal, tenant, resource, policy, source digest, approval expiry, and pre-state before any future side effect.

source.falsifier: Any external material requires pinned source, exact spans, rights scan, and human review.

rights.attribution: No external source is copied; future candidates must record attribution obligations.
rights.retention: No external source or client data is retained.
access_limits: Synthetic fixture only; no gated or private source was accessed.

adaptation_log: No repository extraction or code transformation occurred.

lineage.derivation: Research artifact only; no implementation artifact is derived.

owner.decision_authority: Cannot authorize implementation, release, client access, or block admission.
owner.continuity_owner: Phase-2 coordinator; callback delivery is separate from admission.

tenancy.isolation_boundary: No host, database, service, or client tenant is connected; future execution must bind tenant identity.
tenancy.data_owner: No client data; synthetic fixture only.
tenancy.secrets: No credentials or production secrets are present.
tenancy.retention: No client data retained; future retention is an admission prerequisite.
tenancy.deletion: Discard synthetic fixture/run; future deletion owner is unassigned.

cost.lineage: No usage, pricing, model, sandbox, review, support, or deployment telemetry collected.
cost.correction_window: Must be declared before a cost claim.
cost.falsifier: Do not use per-call price as cost per successful outcome; include repair, review, sandbox, support, and recovery.

maintenance.freshness_source: Source, dependency, standard, runtime, and policy versions each need an observation date.
maintenance.dependency_policy: Pinned versions and source/build/deploy dependency views are required.
maintenance.support_boundary: No support or SLA is promised.
maintenance.correction_path: Open a linked correction receipt; do not silently overwrite evidence.
maintenance.end_of_life: Owner, deprecation date, successor, and rollback target are required before release.

recovery.recovery_falsifier: Description is not proof; a future drill must prove the relevant domain path.

admission.revocation: Not applicable while not_admitted; future release needs a revocation path.
admission.reason: Research schema and synthetic fixture; missing or unexecuted gates keep every candidate not_admitted.
